formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ p p' l l' : Fin N, p ≠ p' → l ≠ l' → ¬ (I p l ∧ I p l' ∧ I p' l ∧ I p' l')) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N + N) C → (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) C z = true ↔ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) → ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 D ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N + N) D ∧ D.size ≤ C.size ∧ (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) D z = true ↔ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) ∧ (∀ j < D.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∀ p0 l0 : Fin N, ¬ I p0 l0 → (D.wires (List.ofFn (fun ke : Fin (N + N) => decide (ke = Fin.castAdd N p0 ∨ ke = Fin.natAdd N l0)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false) ∧ (∀ j < D.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → (∀ p : Fin N, (D.wires (List.ofFn (fun kc : Fin (N + N) => decide (kc = Fin.castAdd N p)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false) ∧ ∀ l : Fin N, (D.wires (List.ofFn (fun kd : Fin (N + N) => decide (kd = Fin.natAdd N l)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false))
plain_statement: It is false that: 4-cycle-free incidence, N points and N lines: every AND/OR fan-in-two circuit computing it has one no larger, also computing it, in which every AND gate is false at every input with exactly one input on and at every input with exactly one point and one line on that are not incident.
title: It is false that: 4-cycle-free incidence: every AND/OR fan-in-two circuit has a no-larger one whose ANDs are false at one-hot and non-incident point-line inputs
